title: Common Foods
description: Learn Tamil words for everyday staple foods — rice, curry, vegetables, and more.

exercises.explanation: These four foods are the backbone of Tamil cuisine — saadam (rice) is eaten at every meal.

exercises.question: How do you say 'I want rice' in Tamil?
exercises.explanation: 'Enakku saadam vendum' = I want rice. 'Enakku vendum' is how you express wanting something.
'Idli' are steamed fermented rice cakes — a beloved Tamil breakfast staple.
'Kozhi' means chicken in Tamil. 'Enakku kozhi vendum' = I want chicken.
'Dosai irukka?' = is there dosai? / do you have dosai? — a crispy fermented crepe.

exercises.question: What is 'thayir' in English?
exercises.explanation: 'Thayir' means yogurt or curd — 'thayir saadam' (curd rice) is a beloved Tamil comfort food.
'Enakku meen kari vendum' = I want fish curry. Object comes before 'vendum' (want).
'Saadam' specifically refers to cooked rice — the centerpiece of a Tamil meal.
